methods.label: Make the function's input equal 5
methods.explanation:
To obtain \(f(5)\) from the given identity, choose \(x\) so that \(3x-1=5\). Solving gives \(x=2\), which is allowed because the identity holds for every real \(x\). Substituting yields
\[
f(5)=f(3\cdot2-1)=2^2+2+1=7.
\]
Thus \(\boxed{f(5)=7}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
